county_geography.warning: County shapes and names come from the actual state GIS service, not approximate art. Only 20 counties on the 2022-2026 Iowa CD1 statutory list may be rendered. If unavailable, a source error is shown; no substitute geometry.

town_pins_source_note: Each pin denotes a verified city-level location, NOT a precise workplace address or a facility entrance. Existing five city coordinates from U.S. Census TIGER incorporated-place centroids; Pella, Fairfield and Newton from cited geographic sources.
